facts.claim: Nizamabad Town is the headquarters of the district and taluk of the same name in Hyderabad State.
facts.quote: Nizamabad Town (or Indur).— Head-quarters of the District and taluk of the same name in Hyderabad State, situated in 18° 40' N. and 78° 6' E., on the Hyderabacl- Godavari ’alle) Railway.

facts.claim: The population of Nizamabad in 1901 was 12,871.
Nizamabad contains a central jail, a dispensary, and a district post office.
